purpose: Prevent a C3 pass from being interpreted as qualification when the deterministic decade anchors coincide with endpoint values in the C2 failure probes.

random_component.sampling_coordinate: uniform in asinh(h/0.01cm) for each endpoint, filtered to strong dry-to-wet contrasts

holdout_construction.materials: at minimum the C2 failing synthetic classes reference_sand and very_fast; if passed, run unchanged candidate over the complete synthetic material set

required_checks: same active-flux relative-error thresholds as C2
same strong-gradient p90 threshold as C2
same dormant scaled-absolute threshold as C2
zero coverage failures inside declared envelope
report p50/p90/p99/max and worst-case endpoint pair
report table bytes and offline-oracle preparation count unchanged from frozen C3 candidate

decision_rule.if_C3_fails: C3B_NOT_RUN; localize C3 first without changing this holdout design
